news.title: NATO chief faces challenge at summit as Trump demands 'loyalty' and not just burden-sharing
news.summary: Since he started work as NATO secretary-general almost two years ago, Mark Rutte has spent much of his time trying to keep the United States anchored to the world's biggest military alliance.
